title: 短暂的在场
standfirst: 潮汐退去，船只经过。有人穿过光，有人在窗边停留。
standfirstEn: Tides recede. A boat passes. Someone crosses the light; someone pauses by a window.
introduction: 沙洲在水中显出轮廓，渡船上的乘客望向岸边，雨后的路面留着霓虹。这些照片来自相距很远的地方；流动的线、人的身影与一道划开空间的光，却不断把它们带到一起。
十四幅照片从海面与屋顶开始，逐渐走向岸边、街巷和室内。它们在这里重新相邻，让目光在远处与近处之间往返。
introductionEn: A sandbank takes shape in the water. A ferry passenger looks towards the shore. A wet road holds the neon. These photographs come from distant places, brought together by lines of movement, human figures and light crossing a space.

Fourteen photographs begin with the sea and rooftops, then move towards the shore, streets and interiors. Placed alongside one another here, they let the eye travel between what is far away and what is close at hand.

chapters.title: 水面，余迹
chapters.text: 礁石在蓝色里铺开纹理，船的航迹把海面划出一条细线。目光降到岸边，岩石、白鸟与亭子的倒影逐渐进入画面。
chapters.textEn: Reefs spread a texture through the blue; a boat's wake draws a thin line across the sea. As the view descends to the shore, rocks, a white bird and the reflection of a pavilion come into the frame.

chapters.title: 与人擦肩
chapters.text: 楼宇之间，人与街道的尺度悬殊；渡船和灶台旁，距离又变得很近。一些日常在擦肩的片刻进入画面，也保留着各自的去向。
chapters.textEn: Between buildings, people appear small against the street; beside a ferry seat or a stove, the distance closes. These daily scenes enter the frame in passing, each continuing on its own course.

chapters.title: 光的停留
chapters.text: 光把墙面分成明暗，也让人影、门框与树枝有了轮廓。从室内的一道斜线到林间铺开的树影，空间在光里重新显露。
chapters.textEn: Light divides a wall into brightness and shade, outlining figures, doorways and branches. From a diagonal inside a room to shadows spreading through the trees, light reveals the shape of a space.

artistStatement: 我是 Power，生活和工作在上海。这份选辑从海岸、街巷与日常空间中展开，把相距很远的地方放在一起观看。
在这些照片里，我关心的是人与环境之间的距离，以及光如何改变一个地方的样子：一位渡船上的乘客、一道通向庭院的门、船驶离后留在水面的线。它们使一个短暂的片刻有了可以反复观看的形式。
artistStatementEn: I’m Power, based in Shanghai. This selection moves through coasts, streets and everyday spaces, bringing distant places into the same field of view.

In these photographs, I’m concerned with the distance between people and their surroundings, and how light changes the appearance of a place: a ferry passenger, a gate opening onto a courtyard, a line left on the water after a boat has passed. A brief encounter becomes a form we can return to.
